items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: The first year out of the hospital, I asked Dr. Preacher. I said, Doc, I said, we all right to walk a parade?

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. He played a many parades. He played a lot of music. It's a wonderful thing. I just like music. I don't know how I just like music. It's one of those kind of things. When you like something, you want to stop. My wife tell me all the time, old man, you're getting old. I say, it looks like the older I get, the better I feel. You know. Good that you like music. I really like music. The first year out of the hospital, I asked Dr. Preacher. I said, Doc, I said, we all right to walk a parade? I put the bass…
And have three or four watermelons. Three or four watermelons. Pot of red, beat the rice. He used to wake in a watermelon. The fruit business. That's what I do now.
